names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 25 ianuarie, «Sfântul Cuvios Publie».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 25 Ιανουαρίου, «Όσιος Πούπλιος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's own heading for 25. јануар ст. ст. (civil 2026-02-07), „Преподобни Публије“. The rank word „Преподобни“ is left off and the heading gives no epithet, so the form stands bare; the entry's body is what places him — a senator who gave his goods away and took up the ascetic life „у близини свога града Зевгмата на Еуфрату“, near his own city of Zeugma on the Euphrates, and it gives the year of his repose as 380.
